g.text: API application: all components (C3, single view)
Language model: hosted or self-hosted, decision pending
L1 to L11 follow a load (view 2); Q1 to Q8 follow a question (view 3). Pink arrows show a correction (UC-09). Dotted arrows show the scheduled retention job.
Bronze, silver and gold are schemas of the platform database, all under row-level security.
